answer: Sparrows flock; a raven flies apart. Cohort analysis makes each agent prove it is the raven, not a sparrow hiding in a flock. At registration the ledger computes pairwise fingerprints - join timing, style embeddings, attestation-graph overlap - and clusters lookalikes as kin. Kin share one draw on the reward vault per epoch: N clones split a single payout while each still pays full inference cost, so return per identity falls as 1/N and the farm runs at a loss.
